mounting.contact: custom plate transfers bridge case to large sink base; broad independent clamp
mounting.support: chassis-supported sink and plenum; no heatsink load through bridge leads
mounting.isolation: insulated plate/fasteners and mains creepage require safety review

shared_heat_load_screen.interpretation: Conditional distributed-load screen only; catalog resistance, local spreading, fan pressure and heat partition require system evidence.

airflow_requirement.fan_curve_basis: Sanyo 12 V curve on catalog page 183; approximately 100 CFM at a low tens-of-pascals point
airflow_requirement.validation: Measure or solve the fan/system intersection; 120 CFM free-air and 100 Pa shutoff are endpoint ratings, not a simultaneous point.

limitations: duct pressure, recirculation and flow distribution unverified
DigiKey availability snapshot must be rechecked before ordering
